reference.question: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(AC=4\), and \(BC=3\). Find \(\tan A\). (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Definition of tangent

\(\tan A=\text{opposite side}/\text{adjacent side}=BC/AC=3/4\).
